user.title: Connect to moschee.io
user.description:
Home Assistant pairs with your mosque on moschee.io like a Smart-Mosque-Box. You confirm a code on moschee.io in the next step.

This integration is in beta. The sound desk's channels work with Behringer X32 desks only for now.

data_description.environment: Only for testing previews of moschee.io.

reauth_confirm.title: Connect to moschee.io again
reauth_confirm.description: moschee.io no longer knows this Home Assistant, for example because the connection was removed under Smart Mosque → Mischpult → Einrichtung. Pair again with a new code.

progress.wait_for_approval: Open [{url}]({url}) while signed in as an owner or admin of your mosque and confirm the code **{code}**. Home Assistant continues on its own.

abort.already_configured: This Home Assistant is already connected to this mosque.
abort.cannot_connect: moschee.io could not be reached. Try again later.
abort.denied: The code was declined on moschee.io.
abort.expired: The code expired before it was confirmed. Start again.
abort.not_linked: The code was confirmed, but not for a mosque. Confirm it while a mosque is selected on moschee.io.

init.title: Switches for moschee.io
init.description: Choose the switches moschee.io may see and switch, for example the power of the sound desk. They appear next to the Mischpult in moschee.io and in the app, and the mosque's switch rules can switch them at the prayer times.

confirm.title: Ask before switching off
confirm.description: moschee.io asks before switching these off, and warns while a translation is live.

auth_failed.message: moschee.io no longer knows this Home Assistant. Connect it again.

not_allowed.message: moschee.io only lets this Home Assistant view the desk. Change it under Smart Mosque → Mischpult → Einrichtung → Home Assistant.

relay_offline.message: Not connected to moschee.io right now.

desk_timeout.message: The desk did not answer in time.

desk_refused.message: The desk refused: {code}. A protected channel stays on during the prayer.
